context.project: Synthetic local test fixture (not real user interface)
context.constraints: data density, long names, 31 day columns
context.unknowns: Original design system, real participants and production behavior unavailable.

findings.title: Table visually clipped on narrow screen
findings.expected: All dates reachable without loss of row identity
findings.impact: Main task impossible on narrow screens
findings.recommendation: Enable overflow scroll or intentional mobile day-detail view using existing table components
findings.verification: On 375px viewport reach and edit day 31, retain employee identity and keyboard focus.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

findings.title: Edit hit targets tiny
findings.expected: Keyboard/touch-accessible action target with appropriate spacing or exception
findings.recommendation: Increase hit area or provide accessible cell edit mode without changing desired density
findings.verification: Inspect measured target geometry and spacing, navigate by keyboard, test on touch.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

findings.title: Status indicated only by dot
findings.evidence: Color dot has no accessible name or visible text
findings.expected: Text or accessible semantic status backed by domain value
findings.verification: Check status without colors, check screen-reader label and actual state mapping.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

state_coverage: Edit/save/locked/approved are unverified and require review.
responsive_coverage: 375 CSS px, table horizontally clipped; check 1300 and zoom in real application.
accessibility_coverage: Button target geometry and color-only status observed; full keyboard/AT check pending.
validation_limits: Synthetic DOM/CSS checks and one width only, not WCAG certification or human usability test.
